MATHEMATICS — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #15
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Solve for x: x + 6 = 13. (1 mark)
   A. 13
   B. 7
   C. 8
   D. 6

2. In the number 3543, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 4
   B. 400
   C. 40
   D. 10

3. A square plot has side 6 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 24
   B. 12
   C. 42
   D. 36

4. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 7 cm and 24 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 27
   B. 25
   C. 31
   D. 17

5. What is 8 × 9? (1 mark)
   A. 17
   B. 1
   C. 73
   D. 72

6. What is the square of 5? (1 mark)
   A. 26
   B. 5
   C. 10
   D. 25

7. In the number 3143, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 40
   B. 4
   C. 400
   D. 10

8. What is 8 × 7? (1 mark)
   A. 57
   B. 1
   C. 56
   D. 15

9. A square plot has side 9 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 90
   B. 18
   C. 36
   D. 81

10. What is the square of 7? (1 mark)
   A. 14
   B. 7
   C. 50
   D. 49

11. What is 4 × 8? (1 mark)
   A. 33
   B. 12
   C. 32
   D. 4

12. What is 4 × 6? (1 mark)
   A. 24
   B. 25
   C. 10
   D. 2

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. Show full working: A trader sells 14 items at Ksh 70 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

14. Show full working: A trader sells 15 items at Ksh 75 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

15. Show full working: A trader sells 16 items at Ksh 80 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

16. Show full working: A trader sells 17 items at Ksh 85 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)
